description: Ministry of Health - The Regulations for the Issue of Lot Release Certificate for Vaccines and Sera, No. 1 of 2019
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, establishing legal requirements for the issuance of Lot Release Certificates for vaccines and sera. It creates a regulatory framework with compliance requirements, testing protocols, and enforcement procedures, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, but rather on establishing binding legal regulations.
